name: Minimoog Monophonic
description: Minimoog-style monophonic three-oscillator synthesizer with 24 dB ladder filter, white/pink noise, separate filter/loudness ADS contours, decay-after-release switch, oscillator-3/noise modulation, keyboard tracking, mixer saturation and optional velocity response. Last-note priority; touching/overlapping notes share one voice and both envelopes. Glide uses Legato half-time (default 0.065 s); larger values slide more slowly. A gap restarts envelopes and pitch directly. Rack values refresh at phrase start. Range 0=Lo, 1=32ft, 2=16ft, 3=8ft, 4=4ft, 5=2ft. Wave 1=triangle, 2=triangle/saw blend (reverse saw on Osc 3), 3=saw, 4=square, 5=25% pulse, 6=12.5% pulse. Osc 3 keyboard off uses C4 as reference; Lo gives about 4.1 Hz. For vibrato: Osc 3 range 0, keyboard off, mixer off; oscillator modulation on and increase modulation amount. Suggested MIDI range 36-84. Route Stereo Output to Master. Inspired by the original architecture, not a circuit-exact emulation; no external audio input or hardware CV.

mixer::a.expression: 0.22 * ((osc1 + tri1) * level1 + (osc2 + tri2) * level2 + osc3 * level3 + noise * noiselevel)
